subtitle: We'll read the lines of destiny inscribed in your palm
analyzing: Reading the destiny held in your palm lines
instruction.showPalm: Open your palm and hold it up to the camera
instruction.lighting: Make sure palm lines are visible in bright lighting
instruction.fullPalm: Ensure your entire palm fits within the frame
handSizeOmen.large.0: Large hands signify great ambition — you have the capacity to embrace the world.
handSizeOmen.large.1: A wide palm is the sign of wealth gathering — prosperity shall follow.
handSizeOmen.large.2: These are the hands of a leader, blessed with the power to guide others.
handSizeOmen.medium.0: Harmonious hands foretell a balanced life, free from excess.
handSizeOmen.medium.1: Well-proportioned hands carry practical wisdom within.
handSizeOmen.medium.2: Capable hands that can accomplish any task set before them.
handSizeOmen.small.0: Delicate hands are gifted in fine work — artistic talent dwells within.
handSizeOmen.small.1: Clever hands that find great value in the smallest things.
handSizeOmen.small.2: Swift hands that seize opportunities before others.
fingerOmen.ringDominant.0: Long ring fingers indicate strong decisiveness — you thrive in competition.
fingerOmen.ringDominant.1: Action comes naturally — you achieve through practice and dedication.
fingerOmen.ringDominant.2: An adventurous spirit resides here — success awaits in new challenges.
fingerOmen.indexDominant.0: Long index fingers signal strong leadership — you are born to guide others.
fingerOmen.indexDominant.1: Self-assurance runs deep — your convictions are clear and firm.
fingerOmen.indexDominant.2: Ambition dwells in these hands — you reach for the highest peaks.
fingerOmen.balanced.0: Balanced fingers reflect a harmonious nature — you get along well with all.
fingerOmen.balanced.1: Reason and emotion unite in harmony — your judgment is sound.
fingerOmen.balanced.2: These hands know moderation — you never fall to extremes.
palmOmen.long.0: A long palm carries strong intuition — your premonitions prove true.
palmOmen.long.1: Hands of deep thought — scholarly talent resides within.
palmOmen.long.2: Rich artistic sensibility — you pursue beauty in all things.
palmOmen.square.0: A square palm is a practical sign — success in worldly affairs awaits.
palmOmen.square.1: Stable hands that inspire trust in others.
palmOmen.square.2: Exceptional organizational skill — you handle tasks with precision.
palmOmen.balanced.0: A harmonious palm balances the ideal and the real — mastery in all things.
palmOmen.balanced.1: Flexible hands that adapt to any situation.
palmOmen.balanced.2: Versatile talent — you shine in many fields.
line.lifeLine.name: Life Line
line.lifeLine.desc: The curved line from between thumb and index finger to the wrist
line.headLine.name: Head Line
line.headLine.desc: The horizontal line across the palm (below the heart line)
line.heartLine.name: Heart Line
line.heartLine.desc: The horizontal line just below the fingers
line.fateLine.name: Fate Line
line.fateLine.desc: The vertical line in the center of the palm
lineOmen.lifeLine.strong: Your life line runs deep and clear — you were born with robust vitality. A long and healthy life awaits.
lineOmen.lifeLine.clear: A distinct life line speaks of overflowing energy. You shall lead a vibrant life.
lineOmen.lifeLine.moderate: An average life line suggests steady health. Regular self-care will serve you well.
lineOmen.lifeLine.faint: A faint life line calls for better health management. A regular routine will help.
lineOmen.lifeLine.unclear: The life line is hard to discern — open your palm wider and try again.
lineOmen.headLine.strong: Your head line runs deep and long — exceptional wisdom dwells within. Great scholarly achievement awaits.
lineOmen.headLine.clear: A clear head line reveals a brilliant mind. Your plans are flawless.
lineOmen.headLine.moderate: An average head line suggests practical wisdom. Growth comes through experience.
lineOmen.headLine.faint: A faint head line suggests reliance on intuition. Emotion leads before reason.
lineOmen.headLine.unclear: The head line is hard to discern — improve the lighting and try again.
lineOmen.heartLine.strong: Your heart line runs deep and long — deep affection resides within. You love with all your heart.
lineOmen.heartLine.clear: A clear heart line reveals a warm heart. Rich relationships shall bless your life.
lineOmen.heartLine.moderate: An average heart line shows emotional balance. Reason and feeling are in harmony.
lineOmen.heartLine.faint: A faint heart line suggests difficulty expressing emotions. Opening your heart will serve you well.
lineOmen.heartLine.unclear: The heart line is hard to discern — relax your hand and try again.
lineOmen.fateLine.strong: Your fate line is deep and clear — you are destined for great achievement. Social success shall be yours.
lineOmen.fateLine.clear: A vivid fate line reveals clear purpose. You will walk one path with unwavering dedication.
lineOmen.fateLine.moderate: An average fate line says you are finding your way. When the time comes, you shall shine.
lineOmen.fateLine.faint: A faint fate line suggests a free spirit. You refuse to be bound by convention.
lineOmen.fateLine.unclear: The fate line is hard to find — your destiny is yet unwritten. You shall forge it yourself.
mainMessage.strongLines: Your palm lines are vivid and clear — born under a strong fortune. Blessings overflow.
mainMessage.detectedLines: Reading your palm reveals auspicious energy. Live according to the destiny inscribed in your hands.
mainMessage.default.0: Auspicious energy flows through your hands. Fortune and blessings are inscribed in your palm lines.
mainMessage.default.1: Reading the destiny in your hands — heaven watches over you.
mainMessage.default.2: These are precious hands — blessings dwell in everything they touch.
mainMessage.default.3: Good energy lingers in your palm — the future is bright.
mainMessage.largeSqaure: Large hands with a sturdy palm — wealth and power shall follow.
mainMessage.indexLong: A leader's spirit combined with deep thought — you are destined for great endeavors.
mainMessage.smallLong: Delicate and sensitive hands — you shall shine in art and creation.
advice.0: Keep your hands clean and nails tidy — fortune will increase.
advice.1: The left hand reveals your born destiny, the right hand the one you create — cherish both.
advice.2: Spread your hands often to receive energy — blocked fortune will open.
advice.3: Let sunlight touch your palms — positive energy gathers.
advice.lifeLineFaint: Your life line is faint — boost your energy with regular exercise and ample rest.
advice.headLineStrong: Your head line is strong — pursue scholarly or research endeavors for great achievement.
advice.heartLineStrong: Your heart line runs deep — express your feelings to loved ones, and bonds will deepen.
advice.fateLineNotDetected: Your fate line is faint — this means you must forge your own destiny. Move forward without fear.
